name: Band Reverse Fly
steps: Anchor a band at chest height, face it holding both ends ahead of you, and step back into tension.
Brace your core with knees softly unlocked and maintain a slight bend in both elbows.
Sweep both arms wide out to your sides until they align with your torso, squeezing your rear delts.
Guide your hands slowly back together in front of your chest under full control.
tips: Hold the slight elbow bend steady throughout rather than bending and straightening into a row.
Avoid arching your lower back or shrugging your shoulders as your arms open wide.
